title: OSF machine settings — sites/<site>/settings/<instance>.settings.json
description: Setting bands of ONE machine instance, independent of any recipe (owner 24.09.2026). The class (profile settings[]) declares which settings exist; this file holds the values of one instance. Owner Maintenance. lint-settings checks it against the plant tree and the class.

instanceRef.description: id of a Unit in the plant tree

class.description: must equal the class of that instance

values.description: ref -> [lo, hi] or { warn, action }; every ref is declared in the class settings[]
